text:
eva: Proposal: run short, timeboxed DP cohorts (2 weeks active) to get denser, comparable feedback.
omar: Makes sense. How many partners per cohort?
eva: Target 6-8, with 1-2 heavy integrators.
meera: Recruitment risk vs rolling invites. need tight screener + perks.
sam: Perks: priority onboarding, direct triage, optional co-marketing. 1:1 onboarding session included.
eva: Draft success metrics:
- 6+ partners meet commitment (>=2 live sessions + weekly async)
- 2 integration pilots with >4k tokens/day sustained for 3+ days
- >=5 actionable GH issues with repro steps per cohort
- no P0 latency/regression vs baseline
meera: Add feedback quality: >=3 reproducible bugs or spec proposals.
nina-legal: For traces, use "share redacted traces" and offer optional DPA addendum for sensitive customers.
sam: I'll write invite copy and landing page.
meera: Screener (keep short):
```
1) primary workload (chat/generate/embeddings)
2) estimated daily tokens (range)
3) product stage (prototype/shipping)
4) data sensitivity (can share redacted traces?)
5) willing to run short integration test? (Y/N)
```
omar: Runtime will run an eval harness against golden outputs after each deploy; needs prompt sets from product.
meera: I'll own prompt sets and the Notion feedback template. sam owns facilitation and the partner Slack channel.
deploy-bot: There are no DP-targeted deploys scheduled in the next 7 days.
eva: Timeline: 1wk recruit, 2wk active, 1wk wrap = 4wks. Pilot start target: 3wks out. Gate to wider preview: >=80% actionables triaged/fixed or scheduled, no P1/P0 regressions, engagement thresholds met.
sam: Also include an optional "drop-in" path for partners who can't do full sync cadence.
eva: Thanks all. sam to post invite draft tomorrow; nina to post legal wording EOD; omar+meera pair Monday 10am to wire harness.
